algorithm_definitions.residual_GAM: positive firstprobe g1=gradL(theta+.05*N(g0)); g2=gradL(theta+1*N(g1−g0)); g3=gradL(theta+1*N(g1−g0)+.05*N(g2)); U=g0+(g3−g2); update restored theta−eta*U
algorithm_definitions.SF_G2: descending firstprobe theta−eta*g0; g1^− there; v=(g0−g1^−)/||g0−g1^−|| aboveeps; g2=gradL(theta+.25*v); U=g2; final restored theta−eta*g2
algorithm_definitions.normalization: Preserve each frozen kernel exactly: GAM norm+eps, S_F division by norm aboveeps, no final-gradient normalization.

interpretation_limits: Changing Task0 method changes the endpoint, trajectory, gradient magnitude and reading cost; this cannot prove trajectory-only rather than endpoint-only effects.
Early/late policies intentionally operate under different sections of a common cosine schedule. No method-switch LR restart is permitted; phase efficacy is not isolated from eta/norm/time.
Retention benefit must be read alongside Task0 acquired accuracy and Task1 new-task learning; a poorly learned Task0 or suppressed Task1 can otherwise appear to forget less.
Joint40 classification includes new-head competition; old20-only accuracy is a useful auxiliary, not a replacement for primary joint40 outcomes.
S_F descending-response G2 and upward-GAM internal G2 are different construction families. Neither directionname alone permits pooling results.
Three paired seeds support descriptive robustness under this20epoch2task protocol; no10task or50epoch outcome claims follow.
